title: Acana Hanging Moth Killer & Freshener, 4 Pack - Lavender Fragrance, Natural Oils - For Wardrobes - Protects Clothing & Bedding - Each Lasts 6 Months
bullet_points: HANGING MOTH KILLER. Acana's lavender scented hanging sachets both freshen wardrobes and safely kill moths, eggs and larvae. Hung conveniently amongst clothing in your wardrobes – Will not stain

AUTOMATIC END OF LIFE INDICATOR. Each lasts for up to 6 months and has an indicator which displays "end" when the sachet has reached the end of its useful life and needs to be replaced. Use 1 or 2 per wardrobe
LAVENDER FRAGRANCE. Protects all clothing and bedding, including woollens, cashmere, linens, furs, leathers & silk. Simultaneously freshens with a light Lavender fragrance, with natural oils
EACH UNIT LASTS 6 MONTHS. Uses the latest technologies in Moth Killing & Fragrancing. Effectively kills moths, their eggs and larvae safely. Each unit lasts up to 6 months

ABOUT US. Founded in 2008, Acana has developed a range of trusted products, covering insect control to moisture control. Our years of experience in the industry have enabled us to become the number one leader in the market for moth killing products
